name: automated-codejson-generator
description: Github Action that allows for automated code.json creation and maintenance
longDescription: This GitHub Action is designed to streamline the maintenance of code.json files, which are essential for adhering to the Federal Source Code Policy in federal open source projects. It automatically calculates and updates critical metadata, including programming languages, repository details, and labor hours, ensuring that these compliance metrics are consistently accurate across all repositories. The system enforces quality control by running automated validation checks on any manual edits made to the code. This validation prevents invalid code.json configurations from being merged into the main branch, thereby guaranteeing schema consistency and maintaining regulatory compliance throughout the development lifecycle.
